brand.tagline: Play for real cash pots. Adult soccer leagues & monthly weekend cash cups.
brand.aboutText: PITCHPOT connects competitive and recreational adult soccer squads with verified turf venues, transparent cash prize pools, split-pay team checkout, and fair mid-season transfer & 4-game loan rules.
brand.rulesSummary: Mandatory digital liability waiver required before kickoff. Permanent transfers are 1-for-1 swaps only. 4-game loans lock players from playing for their parent club for 4 matches. Playoff rosters require minimum regular-season appearances (anti-ringer rule).
